items.t: Nano Dimension Announces 2026 Annual General Meeting (AGM) of Shareholders
items.sum: AGM to be held Tuesday, December 29, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. Israel Time (10:00 a.m. EST)WALTHAM, Mass., Nov. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nano Dimension Ltd. (Nasdaq: NNDM) (“Nano Dimension,” “Nano,” or the “Company”) today announced that it will hold its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders (the “Meeting”, or the “AGM”) on Tuesday, December 29, 2026, at 5:00 p.m., Israel time (10:00 a.m. EST)

Stratasys (NASDAQ:SSYS) reported higher third-quarter revenue and a narrower loss as aerospace and defense demand drove sales, but the 3D-printing company lowered its full-year revenue forecast because several large deals are taking longer to close.
